description:
[read-only] The review links of a brand, newest first: id, title, label, whether each is still active, when it expires and when it was last opened; plus `expiryDays`, the choices create_campaign_share accepts. Never a token or URL: those are shown once, when a link is made. Needs a connection with the write scope. `brandId` from list_brands (a brand-bound connection may omit it).
(Wraps GET /api/v2/campaign-shares.)

brandId.description: Brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key uses its own brand.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

name: list_campaign_shares
title: List campaign review links
